top_issues: Green/violet legend explainer takes prime real estate on first load
Balance bar has tiny sliver hard to read at small $ amounts
fixes: Move onboarding tip to a dismissible tooltip anchored to the bar, not a full card
Add numeric labels on bar segments over ~2px width

top_issues: Route panel and 'before/after' panel both compete for right column attention
Fee 'under 0.01 USDC' phrasing inconsistent with precision elsewhere
Frame # and proof hash shown but no explicit chain/jurisdiction context here
Modal covers home context fully, no quick undo view
QR code lacks amount overlay confirmation before generation
'Prepare incoming account' concept unexplained for first-timers
Order book red/green colors clash with app's violet=risk convention, could confuse
Dense numeric book columns not aligned decimal-to-decimal cleanly at a glance
Collateral slider + tooltip overlapping buttons creates visual clutter
Cross-network atomic swap concept (HTLC-like legs) not explained simply enough for non-experts
fixes: Separate collateral prep into its own step/screen instead of overlay on swap form
Add plain-language 'why two steps' one-liner above legs panel

top_issues: 'Cover it' CTA color same violet as informational text, could be missed
WETH row all zeros adds noise without toggle to hide
Irreversible action button same size/weight as normal buttons risking misclick
No explicit confirmation step shown before dispute submission
fixes: Require secondary confirm (typed amount or hold-to-confirm) for dispute
Increase visual weight/warning color intensity on final CTA

top_issues: Filter tabs (All/Payments/Swaps...) lack active-state emphasis besides subtle fill
Detail panel proof hash truncated without copy affordance visible at rest
Duplicate near-identical screen to 07 wastes review signal, swap-filled state barely differs
'2 committed entries' phrase unexplained jargon
Extremely long single-column settings page requires heavy scrolling
'Reveal recovery phrase' and 'Forget vault' sit close together with similar button weight, risky adjacency
fixes: Group into collapsible sections or sidebar sub-nav
Separate destructive vault actions into their own confirmed danger zone with more spacing

top_issues: Wallet tiles showing 0.00 for unused rails add clutter without collapse option
'Add to batch' feature unexplained, no tooltip
Six similarly-weighted tile choices with no visual priority for most common task (Pay/Move)
'Where your money stands' duplicates home screen bar without added insight
Faucet section (testnet-only) visually equal weight to production wallet balances, confusing for a real user
Collateral slider reused from swap screen crammed into faucet flow, overloaded panel
No APY/market rate context shown, just raw bps input with no benchmark
H1 pool stats (Available/Borrowed/Active) all zero with no historical chart or utilization info
fixes: Show market average rate and utilization % beside input
Add small sparkline/history for pool utilization

top_issues: Very sparse screen for single-signer case, feels unfinished/empty
'Lazy entity' and 'quorum' jargon without inline glossary link
'Per counterparty' card right-edge text ('you in 1d, open -> Manage -> Dispute') clipped/truncated
Evidence bundle save has no preview of contents before download
fixes: Fix truncation with wrap or shorten copy
Add expandable preview of evidence JSON structure

top_issues: Order book table clipped at right edge (cut off column)
Dense table lacks zebra striping or hover state cues for scanning many rows
fixes: Fix table overflow/clip on right panel
Add subtle row hover/alt-row shading for the account table

top_issues: Command palette list has no keyboard shortcut hints per item besides global ⌘K
No recent/frequent commands surfaced first

overall.verdict: A coherent, premium dark fintech UI with a genuinely clever green/violet scale metaphor consistently applied across screens. It loses points on settings sprawl, destructive-action safety, and a few clipped/cluttered secondary screens (swap-cross, desk, lending) that need tightening before it reads as fully shipped.
priority_fixes: Add a hard confirmation step (typed amount/hold) before any dispute or vault-deletion action
Fix table/panel clipping on Desk and cross-network swap screens
Restructure Settings into collapsible sections, isolate destructive vault actions
Separate testnet faucet UI visually from production balances on Assets screen
Add inline glossary/tooltips for jargon (lazy entity, quorum, collateral tariff, HTLC legs)
